_meta.title: Predictive Matrix #1 — Semaglutide × Constitutional Triads
_meta.status: METACOD-RF — Research Framework, not clinical guidance
_meta.hypothesis_statement: Если знаем энергетический профиль препарата и constitutional triad пациента, можно предсказать response pattern. Все прогнозы — HYPOTHESES, не validated predictions; подлежат проверке через retrospective documentation Mark's cases и prospective recording.
_meta.prediction_source: energy profile семаглутида × Constitutional Model v0.2 + Mark's canonical observation (OBS-Mark-001: titration peak / wax-wane / efficacy decay).
predicted_parameters: titration_tolerance — насколько хорошо пациент пройдёт dose titration
peak_adaptation_speed — как быстро снижаются AE после titration peak
late_phase_dominant_AE — какой AE будет доминировать в late phase
predicted_efficacy_magnitude — relative magnitude weight loss / glucose effect
predicted_efficacy_duration — насколько долго therapeutic effect сохраняется до attenuation

energy_profile_recap.primary: Damp-reducing (strong) — appetite suppression + gastric emptying delay + weight loss
energy_profile_recap.tertiary: Drying tendency — при длительном применении возможна Yin depletion
energy_profile_recap.membrane_direction: M-A → M-0 (anabolic correction toward balance); risk overshoot to M-D при длительной therapy

mark_canonical_ae_pattern: Titration peak: nausea, vomiting, GI discomfort при каждом dose increase
Wax/wane: AE снижаются за 2-4 недели, но efficacy тоже attenuates
Late phase: constipation становится dominant AE после resolution of nausea/diarrhea

triads.name: Yang-Earth classic
triads.clinical_phenotype: Abdominal obesity, metabolic syndrome, T2DM с накоплением, sluggish digestion, damp tongue; BMI 32+, HbA1c 7-9%, NAFLD common, strong appetite, coated tongue

triads.name: Yin-Earth chronic
triads.clinical_phenotype: Хроническое накопление, отёки, hypothyroid tendency, fatigue, ожирение медленное; BMI 30-35, cold extremities, slow digestion

triads.name: Yin-Fire (Mark phenotype)
triads.clinical_phenotype: Hidden chronic Heat (high uric acid, hsCRP, normal-borderline hemoglobin), gout episodes, metabolic syndrome + active inflammation, cognitive concerns possible, gout-related joint changes

triads.name: Yang-Water (Anna phenotype)
triads.clinical_phenotype: Brittle vasculature, тенденция к hypotension, history of gastroparesis, respiratory/lung sensitivity, fluid balance issues, small/lean build often

triads.name: Yin-Water frail elderly
triads.clinical_phenotype: 80+, frail, sarcopenic, low BMI или normal weight with low muscle, hypothyroid pattern, cognitive decline possible, cold intolerance, low energy reserve

triads.name: Yin-Metal chronic
triads.clinical_phenotype: Chronic fibrotic processes (IPF history, PBC, scleroderma, autoimmune patterns), ригидность, dry mucosae, chronic cough, normal-to-low BMI

triads.name: Yang-Wood active
triads.clinical_phenotype: Hypertensive patterns, migraine history, hepatobiliary issues (NAFLD, gallstones, elevated LFTs), type A personality часто, irritability, sleep variable

triads.name: Mixed/complex multi-pattern
triads.pattern: Variable, often no clear dominant pattern
triads.clinical_phenotype: Elderly с polypathology, multiple chronic conditions, polypharmacy, pattern recognition difficult, often complex frailty
